findings.issue: This nickname for the Harbinger refers to the same sacred Ova he carries/recovers throughout the game, which is consistently rendered البُيوض elsewhere (frozen in 05_glossary.csv: Ova = البُيوض, NOT a generic word). Here the generic/mundane البيض ('eggs' as food) is used instead, breaking consistency with the sacred-egg register used for this exact concept everywhere else in the corpus.
